title: verbascum × bastardii subsp. pilosum
intro: Verbascum × bastardii subsp. pilosum, commonly known as Bastard's Bee or Mullein, is a perennial plant in the Scrophulariaceae family, characterized by its tall spikes of yellow flowers and woolly leaves. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to address various health issues, providing relief from respiratory problems, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Verbascum × bastardii subsp. pilosum, including flavonoids, saponins, and mucilages, contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects. The plant's extracts have been used in traditional medicine to soothe skin irritations and wounds, and to treat ear infections, thanks to its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties.
